1 भी भ॑यते बिभे॑ति (बिभ्यति), pp. भीत॑ (q.v.)
fear, be afraid of (abl. or gen., r. instr. or acc.);
 fear for, be
anxious about (abl.). C. भीष॑यते (˚ति) & भाययति frighten,
terrify. — नि C put in fright. वि take fright. — Cf. प्रभीत,
विभीत, संभीत.

2 भी॑ f. fear, horror at (abl., loc., acc. w. प्रति, or
—˚).
